fields.v: Yes (1): the authors list their open-source SDAgent implementation as a contribution ('Approach'); it is built on open-source SWE-agent with Gemini-2.5 Pro/Flash APIs, and the cost per project (USD 4.85-7.05) and token use are stated, within reach of a typical team
fields.quote: 3. Approach: A standardized, open-source implementation of end-to-end development agent system, providing a fair baseline for future comparative research.
fields.why: The paper explicitly lists its SDAgent implementation as an 'Approach' contribution, and Q12 already treats the authors as vendor of these configurations, so Q13 N/A is inconsistent with the rule that Q13 applies to studies that propose an approach.
fields.doubt: Na pág. 2 os autores listam como contribuição '3. Approach' a sua implementação open-source dos SDAgents, e em Q12 já os tratas como 'vendor'. Decide se o estudo também propõe uma abordagem (natureza secundária) e se Q13 passa de N/A a Sim (custo USD 4.85-7.05 por projeto, Tabela 3).
